title: achyronia marginalis
intro: Achyronia marginalis, commonly known as Horse Apple, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The plant is said to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Achyronia marginalis include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
